_notes: remove_from_terms is an extra section: entries to delete from terms (kind=word -> add to words; kind=identifier -> add the term to abbreviations-ok in the listed docs, or leave exempt).
overrides entries with kind=identifier mean: delete the override and put the term in that doc's abbreviations-ok.

SYSTEMIC 1: the tokenizer (tests/lib/abbrev.ts WORD) splits compounds at - / . + &, so ~570 first uses sit next to one of those: 'SHA-256' -> 'SHA (Secure Hash Algorithm)-256', 'MS-01', 'FR-4', 'SOT-23', 'PM2.5', 'UD-Q4_K_M', 'GL.iNet', 'USBXHCI.SYS'. Prose-style ones (SHA-256, UDP/TCP, SOPS-encrypted) read acceptably; part numbers and product names do not. The full list was kept as a local scratch file.

SYSTEMIC 2: 'plural' is only used when a doc writes the plural token (64 first uses in the corpus). Most generated plurals for proper nouns ('Advanced Encryption Standards', 'Amsterdam') are never used and harmless; the ones that ARE used and wrong are IP, MAC, MDM, CIDR, SIGKILL, SIGTERM (corrected here).
SYSTEMIC 3: terms the check never flags in any doc today (AVX2 EQ GFX ICE4J LFX LPCM MIPS NVM ROMM TB3 VNNI VOC) are dead entries: harmless, delete or keep.
